chunks: 5. Ali ibn Abd Allah al-Warraq said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abu al-Khattab said: on the authority of Muhammad ibn Aslam al-Jabali, on the authority of al-Khattab ibn Umar and Mus'ab ibn Abd Allah al-Kufiyyin, on the authority of Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

regarding the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: 'Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth; a likeness of His Light is as a niche.' He replied: 'The niche is the Chest of the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in which is the lamp. The lamp is the knowledge in the glass. The glass is the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and the knowledge of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) is with him.'
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth; a likeness of His Light is as a niche.
Chapter: The Commentary of the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: 'They forgot Allah, so He forgot them.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.مُشْكَاة: Niche or cavity in a wall for a lamp

ai.seo_question: How does Shia tradition interpret the symbols in the Quranic Light Verse?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* elucidates the cosmological hierarchy of divine light by mapping the components of the 'Light Verse' onto the Prophet Muhammad, Imam Ali, and divine knowledge. It underscores the Shia doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the continuity of revelation, positioning the Ahl al-Bayt as the pure vessels through which God’s light is transmitted to the world.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 5. `Ali ibn `Abd Allah al-Warraq said: Sa`d ibn `Abd Allah said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abu al-Khattab said: on the authority of Muhammad ibn Aslam al-Jabali, on the authority of al-Khattb ibn `Umar and Mus`ab ibn `Abd Allah al-Kufiyyin, on the authority of Jabir ibn Yazid, that

Abu Ja`far al-Baqir (AS) was asked to interpret the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: `Allah is the light of heavens and the Earth; a likeness of His Light is as a niche.’ He replied: “The niche is the Chest of the Prophet of Allah (SA) in which is the lamp. The lamp is the knowledge in the glass. The glass is the Commander of the Faithful (AS) and the knowledge of the Prophet (SA) is with him (AS).”
